card.name: And after monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: The word "and" (sometimes "that") right after a monitoring or observation instruction, where a second step such as a dose adjustment comes next. Seen in drug interaction advice.

modes.label: Monitor and adjust
modes.description: "and" follows "should be monitored" and introduces a dose change or follow-up action.
modes.example: Theophylline levels should be closely monitored<< and>> theophylline dosage adjustments made,

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "that" or "attention" in a similar spot, after "require" or a clause, leading into a dosage clause.
modes.example: may enhance the metabolism of corticosteroids and require<< that>> the dosage of the corticosteroid

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a passive or action clause that follows, such as a dose being adjusted, rather than words like "our".
card.plain: It fires on the "and" after "should be monitored" that leads into the next action, such as adjusting the dose.
